verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a dedicated mobile app for responding to incidents, viewing account objects, and managing settings on the go, plus mobile schedules and widgets. Community users confirm they get paged through the app and acknowledge from it, with escalation to a phone call if there is no ack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that escalate and resolve actions are available in the mobile app (only generic "respond to incidents" is stated), and independent hands-on evidence beyond acknowledging.
